name: cost-bar
description: /spend toggles a band above the prompt with live API-equivalent spend per model, cache state, context and a next-prompt estimate.

claudeCache.title: Claude cache lifetime
claudeCache.description: 1h on a Claude subscription, usually 5m on an API key (unless ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H is set). Sets the warm/cold timer and the cache-write price.

gptCacheHours.title: GPT cache lifetime (hours)
gptCacheHours.description: How long an idle GPT cache is treated as warm. Azure's newer models document 24 hours.

windowMinutes.title: Recent-spend window (minutes)
windowMinutes.description: The 'last N minutes' figure on the band.

customPrices.title: Custom prices (JSON)
customPrices.description: Override or add models, USD per 1M tokens. Example: {"gpt-6-sol":{"input":2,"output":10,"read":0.2,"write":2.5}}
